findings.severity: fixed in this bundle (root cause, not worked around)
findings.finding: T16's publication validator demanded a char-covering canonical locator for every cited evidence node. Only text/PDF parsers emit char extents; all phase-2 families (office/epub/html/image/media) persist structural locators (block/slide/sheet/bbox) and markdown emitted DOCUMENT-relative extents while chunker spans are node-relative — so no citation into any phase-2 family could ever publish (GroundingError 'evidence has no valid canonical locator'). Invisible to every existing suite (unit tests never cross the real chunk->cite->validate seam); exposed the moment E2E-002 ran one heterogeneous chat turn.
findings.fix: grounding.py _validate_item now accepts the node's primary locator via identity+authorization when it carries no char extents (char-typed locators still require span coverage); markdown locators are node-relative [0, len(text)] with extents dropped from containers; golden-markdown.canonical.json regenerated

findings.severity: app-side prototype limitation (recorded, not fixed — wave-2 item)
findings.finding: Combined chunks (merged neighbor units) publish chunk.char_span of the FIRST unit while the chunk text is longer; harmless for validation (spans stay within the first node) but citation spans under-report the visible evidence text for merged chunks.
findings.workaround: none needed at prototype scope; citations still validate and resolve
